document.abstract: ASA rules require periodic review of all American Standards. In accord with this procedure, the 16mm and 8mm Motion Pictures Committee and the Standards Committee have recently reviewed Z22.50-1946 and reaffirmed it without change. The appropriate ASA committees have now approved this reaffirmation and the standard is therefore published on the following page as a validated 1952 standard.
